title: Complete Side Mission 109’s medicine and cash rewards
consolidation_note: Side Mission109 proposed complete payout in source+two views and regression; exact-head runtime/visual gate required. Keep separate from map geometry.
original_pr_description:
Wondrous Self-Healing Pokémon now lists its complete mission payout in both guide views: ₽4,500, Lucky Egg ×1, Full Restore ×5 and Max Revive ×2. Names Bien and confirms team levels. No change to unlocks, progress keys, feedback, maps, Workspace or Supabase. The ₽4,500 is the mission reward, not a claim about separate battle prize money.

Sources: [Serebii quest and item reward table](https://www.serebii.net/legendsz-a/sidemissions/wondrousself-healingpokemon.shtml), [Thonky full mission payout](https://www.thonky.com/pokemon-legends-z-a/side-mission-109-wondrous-self-healing-pokemon), [GameTrek walkthrough](https://gmtreks.com/pokemon-z-a/side-missions/109).

Rebuilt static homepage from pinned source (baseline rebuilt to the exact tracked blob) and passed `node tests/side_missions_index.test.mjs` in a locally materialized fixture, with linked paths checked against the exact Git tree. CI and preview checks still pending.
